Blasts all enemies within 10 yards of you with arcane energy, dealing Arcane damage. Also goes off where you land after each Blink. Each blast instantly casts one of your other spells, at most once every 0.5 sec.

Launches 5 Arcane Missiles at the nearest enemy over 1 sec, each dealing Arcane damage. With Blink, missiles pile up while you move instead, up to 40, and your next Blink fires them all at the nearest enemies.
Launches 5 Arcane Missiles at the nearest enemy over 1 sec, each dealing Arcane damage. After each Blink, it fires all 5 at once at the nearest enemies and your spells deal 30% more damage for 4 sec.

Summons a three-headed hydra that spits Frost, Fire and Arcane bolts at enemies within 30 yards. Each head picks a different enemy. Its frost head applies Chill and its fire head Burning. It follows you when you move far away.
Summons an elemental that changes school every 5 sec: Water applies Chill, Fire applies Burning, then Arcane.
Smites the 2 nearest enemies for Holy damage. Each Smite reduces the cooldown of Holy Word: Chastise by 1 sec.

Heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec. At full health, it smites the nearest enemy within 30 yards for Holy damage instead. With Power Word: Shield, healing past full health tops up your Shield, up to its size.
A ring of light hits every enemy within 12 yards of you for Holy damage and heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 2%.
The Light strikes the strongest enemy within 30 yards for heavy Holy damage. Each Smite or Halo reduces its cooldown by 1 sec.
Shields you for 10% of your maximum health; each cast tops it back up instead of stacking. You move 10% faster while shielded.

Fires 3 holy bolts at the enemies that struck you in the last 5 sec, or else the nearest enemies, each dealing Holy damage and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health. Healing past full health becomes a Shield, up to 6% of your maximum health.
Normal enemies within 8 yards flee in fear for 2 sec, taking Shadow damage every sec. Elites and bosses are unaffected.
fields.translation: Обычные враги в радиусе 8 ярдов бегут в страхе 2 сек., ежесекундно получая урон Тьмой. Элиты и боссы неуязвимы к этому страху.

fields.english: Strikes the strongest enemy within 30 yards for Holy damage and binds it for 2 sec, dealing Holy damage every sec while bound. Bosses and mini-bosses are struck first but cannot be bound.
Afflicts the 3 enemies farthest from you within 35 yards with 6 stacks of Decay.

Flays the nearest enemy within 20 yards, dealing Shadow damage, applying 1 stack of Decay and slowing it by 30%. Keeps flaying it until it dies or leaves range. Deals 5% more per stack of Decay on the target, up to 30 stacks.
Blasts the enemy with the most Decay for Shadow damage. Every enemy within 8 yards of it gains as many Decay stacks as it has, up to 10.
Summons a Shadowfiend whose attacks apply Decay and whose Shadow Cleave hits every enemy in front of it. Its melee attacks heal you for 0.5% of your maximum health.
fields.translation: Призывает исчадие Тьмы. Его атаки накладывают «Разложение», а удары по области поражают врагов перед ним. Атаки исцеляют вас на 0,5% максимального здоровья.

fields.english: Smites the nearest enemy with holy fire, dealing Holy damage and applying 3 stacks of Burning. Each Smite reduces the cooldown of Holy Word: Chastise by 1 sec.

Smites the nearest enemy for Holy damage. Every 4th Smite also hits enemies within 6 yards of the target and stuns normal enemies for 1 sec. Each Smite reduces the cooldown of Holy Word: Chastise by 1 sec.

Heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec. At full health, it smites the nearest enemy within 30 yards for Holy damage instead. Any healing past full health also smites, at most twice a sec. With Power Word: Shield, healing past full health tops up your Shield, up to its size.

Heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec. At full health, it smites the nearest enemy within 30 yards for Holy damage instead, jumping to 2 additional nearby enemies. With Power Word: Shield, healing past full health tops up your Shield, up to its size.
A ring of light goes off 3 times over 2 sec, each hitting every enemy within 12 yards of you for Holy damage and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 2%.
A ring of light hits every enemy within 12 yards of you for Holy damage, up to 100% more the farther they are, and heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 2%.

The Light strikes the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, for heavy Holy damage, hits enemies within 8 yards of it for half and heals you for 3% of your maximum health. Each Smite or Halo reduces its cooldown by 1 sec.
The Light strikes the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, for heavy Holy damage and resets the cooldowns of Smite and Halo. Each Smite or Halo reduces its cooldown by 1 sec.
Shields you for 10% of your maximum health; each cast tops it back up instead of stacking. You move 10% faster while shielded, and damage it absorbs is dealt back to the attacker as Holy damage.

Shields you for 10% of your maximum health and raises a dome at your feet for 5 sec; you take 25% less damage inside. Each cast tops the Shield back up instead of stacking. You move 10% faster while shielded.

Fires 3 holy bolts at the enemies that struck you last, or 5 while you have a Shield, each dealing Holy damage and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health. Healing past full health becomes Shield.

Fires 3 holy bolts at the enemies that struck you last, each dealing Holy damage, hitting enemies within 4 yards for half and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health. Healing past full health becomes Shield.
Normal enemies within 8 yards flee in fear for 2 sec and take Shadow damage every sec, plus 20% more damage from everything. Elites, mini-bosses and bosses do not flee.
Normal enemies within 8 yards flee in fear for 2 sec, gain 3 stacks of Decay and take Shadow damage every sec. Elites, mini-bosses and bosses do not flee.

Binds the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, for 2 sec. It takes Holy damage when bound and every sec while bound, and 30% more damage from everything. Bosses and mini-bosses cannot be bound but still take the first hit.
Binds the 3 strongest enemies nearby, elites first, for 2 sec. They take Holy damage when bound and every sec while bound. Bosses and mini-bosses cannot be bound but still take the first hit.
Afflicts the 3 enemies farthest from you within 35 yards with 6 stacks of Decay. Your Decay heals you for 2% of its damage, up to 1% of your maximum health a sec.
Afflicts the 3 enemies farthest from you within 35 yards with 6 stacks of Decay and 1 stack of Shadow Vulnerability.

Flays the nearest enemy, dealing Shadow damage to it and half to enemies within 6 yards, applying 1 stack of Decay and slowing it by 30%. Deals 5% more per stack of Decay on the target, up to 30 stacks.

Flays the nearest enemy, dealing Shadow damage, applying 1 stack of Decay and slowing it by 30%. When it dies, its Decay moves to your next target. Deals 5% more per stack of Decay on the target, up to 30 stacks.
Blasts the enemy with the most Decay for Shadow damage. Every enemy within 8 yards of it gains as many Decay stacks as it has, up to 10, then its own Decay deals all its remaining damage at once.
Blasts the enemy with the most Decay for Shadow damage. Every enemy within 8 yards of it takes half and gains as many Decay stacks as it has, up to 10.
Summons a Shadowfiend whose attacks hit enemies within 5 yards of its target, apply Decay and heal you for 0.5% of your maximum health.
Summons a Shadowfiend whose attacks apply Decay and heal you for 0.5% of your maximum health. Every 6 sec it roots normal enemies within 6 yards for 2 sec.
Stabs the nearest enemy for damage.
Your single-target hits also strike 4 more enemies within 8 yards at 50% damage for 8 sec. The extra hits carry your poisons and openers.
Guts the nearest enemy for heavy damage, with double critical strike chance. A kill carries the blow to the next enemy within 8 yards, up to 3 times.
Strikes 8 times over 1.4 sec, each strike hitting a random enemy within 10 yards for damage and carrying your poisons and openers. Each strike reduces the cooldown of Eviscerate by 0.5 sec.
Stabs the nearest enemy with both daggers for damage, each stab applying 1 stack of Poison, plus 1 for every 5 stacks it already has. Deals 30% more to Poisoned enemies.

Your other abilities apply 1 stack of Poison with every hit. Also throws a vial at the largest group of enemies within 20 yards, dealing Nature damage and applying 4 stacks of Poison to every enemy within 8 yards.
Throws knives in every direction, striking all enemies within 10 yards for damage and applying 2 stacks of Poison. Every knife carries your poisons and openers.
Strikes the 3 enemies with the most Poison for Nature damage plus all the damage their Poison would still deal, keeping their stacks. Your hits apply 2 more stacks of Poison for 5 sec.
Throws shurikens at the 3 nearest enemies within 20 yards, ones you have not hit yet first, dealing damage.
Your first hit on each enemy with your other abilities is followed by an Ambush for heavy damage, with double critical strike chance.
Your hits deal 30% more damage for 4 sec and can set off Ambush again, once a sec per enemy.
Increases your dodge chance by 50% for 5 sec, up to 85%.
fields.translation: На 5 сек. увеличивает шанс уклонения на 50%, но не выше 85%.

fields.english: Stabs the nearest enemy for damage, followed by an off-hand stab at a different enemy within 8 yards.
Stabs the nearest enemy for damage. When a stab kills its target, you instantly stab the next nearest enemy, up to 3 times in a row.
Your single-target hits always strike 2 more enemies within 8 yards at 50% damage. The extra hits carry your poisons and openers.
Your single-target hits also strike 4 more enemies within 8 yards at 50% damage as Shadow damage for 8 sec. Extra hits can set off Ambush again, once a sec per enemy.
Guts the 5 nearest enemies for heavy damage, with double critical strike chance. A kill carries the blow to the next enemy within 8 yards, up to 3 times.

Throws a blade at the strongest enemy within 30 yards, elites first, for heavy damage with double critical strike chance. Normal enemies hit are slowed by 50% for 3 sec. A kill carries the blow to the next enemy within 8 yards, up to 3 times.
Strikes 8 times over 2 sec, each strike hitting a random enemy within 10 yards for damage. Each kill adds 2 strikes, up to 20 more. Each strike reduces the cooldown of Eviscerate by 0.5 sec.

Strikes 8 times over 2 sec, each strike hitting a random enemy within 10 yards for damage. The last strike also fires Eviscerate and Envenom, if you hold them, without triggering their cooldowns. Each strike reduces the cooldown of Eviscerate by 0.5 sec.

Stabs the nearest enemy with both daggers for damage, each stab applying 1 stack of Poison, plus 1 for every 5 stacks it already has, and 2 stacks of Nature Vulnerability. Deals 30% more to Poisoned enemies.
Stabs the nearest enemy with both daggers for damage, 3 times below 35% health, each stab applying 1 stack of Poison, plus 1 for every 5 stacks it already has. Deals 30% more to Poisoned enemies.

Your other abilities apply 1 stack of Poison with every hit and slow normal enemies by 30%. Poisoned enemies take 15% more damage from you. Also throws a vial at the largest group of enemies within 20 yards, dealing Nature damage and applying 4 stacks of Poison to every enemy within 8 yards.

Your other abilities apply 1 stack of Poison with every hit and deal 30% extra as Nature damage. Also throws a vial at the largest group of enemies within 20 yards, dealing Nature damage and applying 4 stacks of Poison to every enemy within 8 yards.
Throws knives in every direction, striking all enemies within 10 yards for damage and applying 2 stacks of Poison. Leaves caltrops for 4 sec that slow enemies and add 1 stack of Poison every sec.
Throws knives in every direction, striking all enemies within 10 yards for damage and applying 2 stacks of Poison. Also throws when Eviscerate or Envenom fires.

Strikes the 3 enemies with the most Poison for Nature damage plus all the damage their Poison would still deal, keeping their stacks, and every Poisoned enemy within 8 yards of them for Nature damage. Your hits apply 2 more stacks of Poison for 5 sec.

Strikes the 3 enemies with the most Poison for Nature damage plus all the damage their Poison would still deal, keeping their stacks. They and every Poisoned enemy within 10 yards also take the damage their Poison would deal over the next 4 sec. Your hits apply 2 more stacks of Poison for 5 sec.
Throws shurikens at the 2 nearest enemies within 20 yards, ones you have not hit yet first, dealing damage. Each one jumps to 2 more nearby enemies.
Throws shurikens at the 2 nearest enemies within 20 yards, ones you have not hit yet first, dealing damage. A shadow stays where each hits and bursts 1.5 sec later for Shadow damage within 5 yards.
Your first hit on each enemy with your other abilities is followed by an Ambush for heavy damage, with double critical strike chance. Ambush stuns normal enemies for 1 sec.
Your first hit on each enemy with your other abilities is followed by an Ambush for heavy damage, with double critical strike chance. Ambushed enemies take 20% more damage from you for 6 sec.
Your hits deal 30% more damage for 4 sec and can set off Ambush again, once a sec per enemy. Starts with a vanish: normal enemies within 10 yards lose you and stand dazed for 2 sec.
Your hits deal 30% more damage for 4 sec and can set off Ambush again, once a sec per enemy. Starts with a shadow strike on the 5 strongest enemies within 14 yards for damage.
You dodge 50% more attacks for 5 sec, and every dodge strikes the attacker back for damage.
You dodge 50% more attacks for 5 sec, and enemy attacks miss you half the time while you stand in the smoke at your feet.
Hurls lightning at the nearest enemy, bouncing to 1 more, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static to each.
Hurls lightning at the nearest enemy, jumping to 4 more, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static to each.
Shocks the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, dealing Fire damage and applying 6 stacks of Burning.

Shocks the enemy with the most Static for Nature damage, 50% more per Static stack. Consumes the stacks in a discharge that also hits up to 3 nearby enemies. Each Static stack it consumes restores 1 Lightning Shield charge.
Swings at the nearest enemy for damage. Every 3rd swing calls Windfury: 2 extra swings that also hit enemies within 4 yards of the target.
Strikes the nearest enemy within 12 yards twice, with weapon and lightning, for damage, applying 2 stacks of Static and 2 stacks of Nature Vulnerability. Counts as 2 hits for Maelstrom Weapon.

Every 3rd hit from your other Shaman spells and Feral Spirit bites hurls a free Lightning Bolt at the nearest enemy within 30 yards, or at the 3 nearest if you know Chain Lightning, dealing Nature damage and applying 1 stack of Static. Lightning Shield and totem hits don't count.
Summons 2 spirit wolves whose bites apply 1 stack of Static. Every 3 sec, each wolf cleaves all enemies in front of it within 6 yards.
Plants a Searing Totem at your feet that hurls fire at 2 enemies within 20 yards, applying Burning. It is replanted when you move away.

Hurls a Magma Totem onto the biggest group of enemies within 25 yards. It pulses fire every 2 sec, dealing Fire damage and 1 stack of Burning to enemies within 8 yards, and is hurled again once none are in reach.
Plants a Healing Stream Totem at your feet that heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec while you stay within 15 yards.

Surrounds you with up to 3 lightning charges. Every 1.5 sec it zaps 1 enemy within 10 yards for each charge you hold, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static, and each zap gives you a Shield of 0.5% of your maximum health, up to 5%. An enemy that strikes you spends a charge and is zapped too. One charge returns every 1.5 sec.
Hurls lightning at the nearest enemy, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static. A bolt that sets off a Static discharge also hurls a Chain Lightning from that enemy.
Hurls lava at the enemy with the most Burning, dealing Fire damage. Always critically strikes Burning enemies.
Hurls lightning at the nearest enemy that jumps up to 10 times, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static to each. Each jump deals 15% less.
Hurls Chain Lightning at the 2 nearest enemies, each jumping to 4 more, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static to each.
Shocks the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, dealing Frost damage and applying 6 stacks of Chill.
Shocks the strongest enemy nearby, elites first, dealing Fire damage and applying 6 stacks of Burning. Burning enemies that die fire a Lightning Bolt at once.

Shocks the enemy with the most Static for Nature damage, 50% more per Static stack. Consumes the stacks in a discharge that also hits up to 3 nearby enemies, and the ground shakes for 4 sec, Dazing enemies inside and dealing Nature damage every sec. Each Static stack it consumes restores 1 Lightning Shield charge.

Shocks the enemy with the most Static for Nature damage, 50% more per Static stack. Consumes the stacks in a discharge that also hits up to 3 nearby enemies. Every Static discharge within 10 yards of you also hits enemies within 6 yards of it. Each Static stack it consumes restores 1 Lightning Shield charge.
Swings at the nearest enemy for damage, adding Fire damage and 1 stack of Burning. Every 3rd swing calls Windfury: 2 extra swings that also hit enemies within 4 yards and apply 3 stacks of Burning.
Swings at the nearest enemy for damage. Every 3rd swing calls Windfury: 2 extra swings that also hit enemies within 4 yards. Every 15 sec, every swing calls Windfury for 4 sec.

Strikes the nearest enemy within 12 yards twice, with weapon and lava, for damage, applying 2 stacks of Static, 2 of Nature Vulnerability and 2 of Burning. The lava deals 50% more to Burning enemies. Counts as 2 hits for Maelstrom Weapon.

Strikes the nearest enemy within 12 yards twice, with weapon and lightning, for damage, applying 2 stacks of Static and 2 stacks of Nature Vulnerability. The lightning also hits enemies within 8 yards of you with 1 stack of Static. Counts as 2 hits for Maelstrom Weapon.

Every 3rd hit from your other Shaman spells and Feral Spirit bites hurls a free Lightning Bolt at the 3 nearest enemies, or at the 5 nearest if you have Chain Lightning, dealing Nature damage. Totem hits don't count.

Every 3rd hit from your other Shaman spells and Feral Spirit bites hurls a free Lightning Bolt at the nearest enemy, or at the 3 nearest if you have Chain Lightning, dealing Nature damage and 5 stacks of Static, so it discharges at once. Totem hits don't count.
Summons 2 spirit wolves in fire, frost and lightning forms whose bites apply Burning, Chill or Static.
Summons 2 spirit wolves whose bites apply Static. Each Windfury calls an extra wolf for 6 sec.

Plants a Searing Totem at your feet that hurls fire at an enemy within 20 yards, applying Burning. Every 4 sec it bursts, dealing Fire damage and 3 stacks of Burning to enemies within 8 yards, and is replanted at your feet.
Plants a Searing Totem at your feet that hurls fire at 2 enemies within 20 yards, applying Burning. Enemies within 15 yards of it take 15% more Fire damage.

Hurls a Magma Totem onto the biggest group of enemies within 25 yards. It pulses fire every 2 sec, dealing Fire damage and 1 stack of Burning to enemies within 8 yards, and is hurled again once none are in reach. Each pulse also hurls 2 globs of magma at enemies within 12 yards.

Hurls a Magma Totem onto the biggest group of enemies within 25 yards. It pulses fire every 2 sec, dealing Fire damage and 1 stack of Burning to enemies within 8 yards and Dazing them, and is hurled again once none are in reach.
Summons a Healing Tide Totem that walks with you and heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec.
Plants a Healing Stream Totem at your feet that heals you for 1% of your maximum health every sec while you stay within 15 yards. Every 3 sec it rains on enemies within 10 yards for Nature damage.

Surrounds you with up to 3 lightning charges. Every 1.5 sec it zaps 1 enemy within 10 yards for each charge you hold, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static, and each zap gives you a Shield of 1.5% of your maximum health, up to 15%. An enemy that strikes you spends a charge and is zapped too. One charge returns every 1.5 sec.

Surrounds you with up to 3 lightning charges. Every 1.5 sec it zaps 1 enemy within 10 yards for each charge you hold, plus enemies within 4 yards of each, dealing Nature damage and 1 stack of Static, and each zap gives you a Shield of 0.5% of your maximum health, up to 5%. When an enemy strikes you or your melee hits land, a charge is spent on another zap. One charge returns every 1.5 sec.
Strikes the nearest enemy for heavy damage and 30% of it to enemies within 5 yards of the target.

Slams the 3 strongest enemies within 20 yards for Holy damage, with double critical strike chance. With Seal of Righteousness it deals 50% more damage, with Seal of Command it also hits enemies within 5 yards of each target for half, and with Seal of Light it heals you for 1% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 5%.
Every 2nd strike from your other Paladin spells releases a burst of light, dealing Holy damage to the target and every enemy within 5 yards of it.
Hits from your other Paladin spells, splash included, deal 30% extra as Holy damage. Judgement deals 50% more damage instead. Consecration, Retribution Aura and Seal of Command are not affected.
Consecrates the ground beneath you for 8 sec, dealing Holy damage every sec to enemies on it. You deal 15% more damage while standing on it.

Strikes the strongest enemy within 30 yards for heavy Holy damage. Undead and Demons take triple damage, elites and bosses double. Critical strikes from your other Paladin spells reset its cooldown, at most once a sec.

Holy light bursts around you, dealing Holy damage to all enemies within 10 yards and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 3%. Each enemy hit counts as a strike for Seal of Command, up to 5 bursts.
Every strike from your other Paladin spells heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health, at most 6 times a sec.
A golden bubble forms around you and blocks the next enemy hit that would take more than 5% of your maximum health.
Burns every enemy within 10 yards of you with holy light, dealing Holy damage every sec. Enemies that strike you take double.
Hurls a hammer at the strongest enemy within 20 yards, dealing Holy damage and stunning it for 2 sec. Bosses and mini-bosses are not stunned.
fields.translation: Бросает молот в сильнейшего врага в радиусе 20 ярдов, наносит урон Светом и оглушает на 2 сек. Боссы не оглушаются.

fields.english: Hammers of light fall on 3 random enemies within 25 yards, each dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 5 yards.
Hurls a holy shield at the nearest enemy within 25 yards for Holy damage. It jumps to 4 more enemies within 10 yards, never the same one twice. Each hit counts as a Paladin strike.
Strikes the 2 nearest enemies for heavy damage and 50% of it to enemies within 5 yards of each target.

Strikes the nearest enemy for heavy damage and 30% of it to enemies within 5 yards of the target. Each strike has a 15% chance to hurl a Hammer of Wrath for the same damage, slaying normal enemies below 20% health.

Slams the 3 strongest enemies within 20 yards with a hammer of light for Holy damage, with double critical strike chance. Heals you for 1% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 5%, and releases your other Seals like Judgement.

Slams the 3 strongest enemies within 20 yards with a hammer of light for Holy damage, with double critical strike chance. Judged enemies take 20% more damage from you for 6 sec. Releases your Seals like Judgement.
Every strike from your other Paladin spells releases a burst of light, dealing Holy damage to the target and every enemy within 5 yards of it.
Every 2nd strike from your other Paladin spells releases a burst of light, dealing Holy damage to the target and every enemy within 5 yards of it and stunning normal and elite enemies for 1 sec.
Every hit from your other Paladin spells, splash and area hits included, deals 60% extra as Holy damage.
Every hit from your other Paladin spells, splash and area hits included, deals 30% extra as Holy damage, 20% more for each hit on the same enemy, up to 5 times.
Consecrates the ground beneath you for 12 sec, dealing Holy damage every sec to enemies on it, up to 3 grounds at once. You deal 25% more damage while standing on it.
Consecrates the ground beneath you for 8 sec, dealing Holy damage every sec to enemies on it. While standing on it you deal 15% more damage and heal for 0.5% of your maximum health every sec.

Strikes the 3 strongest enemies within 30 yards for heavy Holy damage. Undead and Demons take triple damage, elites and bosses double. Critical strikes from your other Paladin spells reset its cooldown, at most once a sec.

Strikes the strongest enemy within 30 yards for heavy Holy damage and enemies within 5 yards of it for half. Undead and Demons take triple damage, elites and bosses double. Critical strikes from your other Paladin spells reset its cooldown, at most once every 0.5 sec.

Holy light bursts around you, dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 12 yards and healing you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 5%. Each enemy hit counts as a strike for Seal of Command.

Holy light bursts around you, dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 10 yards and slowing normal enemies by 50%; Undead and Demons are stunned for 1 sec. Heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health per enemy hit, up to 3%. Each enemy hit counts as a strike for Seal of Command.
Every strike from your other Paladin spells heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health, at most 6 times a sec. Falling below 30% health heals you to full, at most once every 90 sec.
Every strike from your other Paladin spells heals you for 0.5% of your maximum health, at most 6 times a sec. Critical strikes heal triple.

A golden bubble forms around you and blocks the next enemy hit that would take more than 5% of your maximum health. Falling below 30% health makes you immune to damage for 2 sec, at most once every 30 sec.
A golden bubble forms around you and blocks the next enemy hit that would take more than 5% of your maximum health, then bursts, dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 10 yards.
Burns every enemy within 12 yards of you with holy light, dealing Holy damage every sec. Enemies that strike you take double.
Burns every enemy within 10 yards of you with holy light, dealing Holy damage every sec. Enemies that strike you take double. You take 10% less damage.
Hurls a hammer at the strongest enemy within 20 yards, dealing Holy damage to it and every enemy within 6 yards and stunning the target for 2 sec. Bosses are not stunned.
Hurls hammers at the 3 strongest enemies within 20 yards, dealing Holy damage and stunning them for 2 sec. Bosses are not stunned.
Hammers of light fall on 5 random enemies within 25 yards, each dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 5 yards.

Hammers of light fall on 3 random enemies within 25 yards, each dealing Holy damage to every enemy within 5 yards. Every 3rd time, an extra hammer hits the largest group for triple damage within 10 yards.
Hurls a holy shield at the nearest enemy within 25 yards for Holy damage. It jumps to 8 more enemies within 10 yards, never the same one twice. Each hit counts as a Paladin strike.

Hurls a holy shield at the nearest enemy within 25 yards for Holy damage. It jumps to 4 more enemies within 10 yards, never the same one twice. Each hit also deals half its damage to enemies within 5 yards of the target and counts as a Paladin strike.
Summons an Imp that hurls 2 Firebolts at a time at enemies within 30 yards, leaving them burning.
fields.translation: Призывает беса, бросающего по 2 огненные стрелы в радиусе 30 ярдов. Стрелы поджигают врагов.

fields.english: Summons a Voidwalker that consumes enemies dying near it. After 8 it bursts in a void nova that hits every enemy around it.
Summons a Succubus whose Lash of Pain strikes all enemies in a wide arc in front of her and applies Shadow Vulnerability.

Summons a Felhunter whose Shadow Bite deals 10% more damage per affliction on the target and interrupts spells, and whose Shadow Cleave hits every enemy in front of it. Every 10 sec it removes a harmful effect from you.
Corrupts 2 enemies within 30 yards, the nearest without Decay first, with 1 stack of Decay, or 2 on an enemy without Decay.
Curses 2 enemies within 30 yards, uncursed enemies with the most health first, with 1 stack of Agony, or 2 on an uncursed enemy. Your Shadow Bolts add 1 stack of Agony to cursed enemies.

Drains the nearest enemy within 16 yards, dealing damage every sec and healing you for 1% of your maximum health per enemy drained, up to 2%. Drained enemies take 20% more damage from your Decay and Agony.

Fires a Shadow Bolt at the nearest enemy, dealing damage, 4% more per stack of Decay on the target, up to 30 stacks. Nightfall: enemies that die with your afflictions on them fire a free bolt, at most 1 a sec.
Strikes the 2 nearest enemies with fire, dealing damage and applying 2 stacks of Burning.
Fire burns every enemy within 8 yards of you, dealing damage and 1 stack of Burning.
Rains fire on the largest group of enemies for 4 sec, dealing damage and applying 1 stack of Burning every sec.
Summons an Imp that hurls 2 Firebolts at a time at enemies within 30 yards, leaving them burning. Firebolts jump to 2 more enemies within 8 yards for 60% damage.
Summons an Imp that hurls 2 Firebolts at a time at enemies within 30 yards, leaving them burning. Enemies its Firebolts kill call a lesser Imp for 6 sec, up to 6 at once.
Summons a Voidwalker that consumes enemies dying near it. After 8 it bursts in a void nova that hits every enemy around it and shields you for 5% of your maximum health.

Summons a Voidwalker that consumes enemies dying near it. After 8 it bursts in a void nova that hits every enemy around it. Every 6 sec it slams the ground within 8 yards, knocking normal enemies away.
Summons a Succubus whose Lash of Pain strikes every enemy around her and applies Shadow Vulnerability.

Summons a Succubus whose Lash of Pain strikes all enemies in a wide arc in front of her and applies Shadow Vulnerability. Every 8 sec she pulls the strongest normal enemy within 20 yards to her; it takes double damage for 2 sec.
Summons a Felhunter whose Shadow Bite deals 10% more damage per affliction on the target and interrupts every caster within 8 yards of it, and whose Shadow Cleave hits every enemy in front of it.

Summons a Felhunter whose Shadow Bite deals 10% more damage per affliction on the target and turns off an elite's affixes for 6 sec, at most once every 10 sec, and whose Shadow Cleave hits every enemy in front of it.
Corrupts the 2 nearest enemies with 1 stack of Decay. Corrupted enemies explode on death, adding 1 stack of Decay to enemies within 6 yards. Explosion kills explode too, up to 2 in a row.
Corrupts the 2 nearest enemies with 1 stack of Decay. Every 6 sec, each corrupted enemy within 30 yards takes the damage its Decay would deal over the next 3 sec, keeping its stacks.

Curses the 2 enemies with the most health with 1 stack of Agony. 10 sec after the first curse, Doom strikes for heavy Shadow damage; if it kills, a Doomguard fights for 15 sec. Your Shadow Bolts add 1 stack of Agony to cursed enemies.

Curses the 2 enemies with the most health with 1 stack of Agony. When a cursed enemy dies, its Agony moves with every stack to the nearest uncursed enemy. Your Shadow Bolts add 1 stack of Agony to cursed enemies.
